usage: kathara vconfig [-h] -n DEVICE_NAME (--add CD/MAC [CD/MAC ...] |
                       --rm CD [CD ...])

Manage the network interfaces of a running Kathara device

options:
  -h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
  -n, --name DEVICE_NAME
                        Name of the device to be connected on desired
                        collision domains.
  --add CD/MAC [CD/MAC ...]
                        Specify the collision domain to add.
  --rm CD [CD ...]      Specify the collision domain to remove.

For examples and further information visit:
https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki
